int64[4] shape_q =  {2,6,8,16}, int64[4] shape_kv =  {2,6,2,16}, int64[1] unsq_axes =  {2}, int64[5] expand_shape =  {2,2,4,6,16}, int64[4] merge_shape =  {2,8,6,16}, float sqrt_dh =  {4}, int64[3] shape_ctx =  {2,6,128}, float[1,1,6,6] mask =  {0,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,0,0,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,0,0,0,-1e+30,-1e+30,-1e+30,0,0,0,0,-1e+30,-1e+30,0,0,0,0,0,-1e+30,0,0,0,0,0,0}>
{
   q_mm = MatMul (x, wq)
   q_r = Reshape (q_mm, shape_q)
   q_t = Transpose <perm: ints = [0, 2, 1, 3]> (q_r)
   k_mm = MatMul (x, wk)
   k_r = Reshape (k_mm, shape_kv)
   k_raw = Transpose <perm: ints = [0, 2, 1, 3]> (k_r)
   k_unsq = Unsqueeze (k_raw, unsq_axes)
   k_exp = Expand (k_unsq, expand_shape)
   k_rep = Reshape (k_exp, merge_shape)
   k_t = Transpose <perm: ints = [0, 1, 3, 2]> (k_rep)
   v_mm = MatMul (x, wv)
   v_r = Reshape (v_mm, shape_kv)
   v_raw = Transpose <perm: ints = [0, 2, 1, 3]> (v_r)
   v_unsq = Unsqueeze (v_raw, unsq_axes)
   v_exp = Expand (v_unsq, expand_shape)
   v_rep = Reshape (v_exp, merge_shape)
   qk = MatMul (q_t, k_t)
   scores = Div (qk, sqrt_dh)
   masked = Add (scores, mask)
   probs = Softmax <axis: int = -1> (masked)
   ctx0 = MatMul (probs, v_rep)
   ctx1 = Transpose <perm: ints = [0, 2, 1, 3]> (ctx0)
   ctx2 = Reshape (ctx1, shape_ctx)
   y = MatMul (ctx2, wo)
}
